items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: matches the iterate spec: classifier lives in stage-2 default-branch code, sensitive-path still blocks, single producer, defensive review_outcome guard.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: not an API route; CLI arg validation via argparse required=True, gate_out empty/garbled falls back to failure closed in the workflow bash.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: no user input reaches SQL/HTML; no eval used to parse the new CLI output; classifier reuses the existing trusted SENSITIVE_PATH_RE and is_generated_path, both derived from the API-read changed-path list per FR-01.17 (E)7.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: asserts on outcomes (state/desc tuples), one happy path (all-generated success) and multiple error/edge paths (sensitive path present, review outcome failure/cancelled/timed_out, empty output) per module.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: no DB or loop-of-calls involved; classifier is a single pass over a small changed-path list.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: all new/changed files under 300 LOC; module split follows the existing mechanism/policy pattern (pr_review_generated vs pr_review_diff_filter).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: two small new producer/consumer pairs: (1) review_record_tier.py CLI stdout -> GITHUB_OUTPUT (all_generated/all_generated_reason), extending the existing needs_review/reason pattern, covered by test_cli_emits_all_generated_outputs; (2) decide_pr_review_gate.py CLI stdout (state=/desc=) -> the workflow's sed-based bash parser, covered by test_decide_pr_review_gate_cli.py and manually traced against the exact sed commands in pr-review-run.yml. Neither is a touches_io_boundary-flagged file pattern (plain key=value text, not JSON/YAML/.env/hooks config).

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings.
